coverage.as_of_meaning: Most recent action_date on this recipient in the warehouse — not the ingest run date and not proof the corpus stopped updating.
coverage.freshness_note: Warehouse ingest freshness was not attached to this payload; do not treat last_recipient_action_date as an ingest lag.

company.name: CYRUS MANAGEMENT SOLUTIONS LLC
company.activity_note: Period-scoped observation for FY2025–FY2026 (reference FY2026): activity_status=dormant. Last FY with an explicit positive-obligation component: FY2020. Federal obligations are not company revenue. A negative net FY can still contain positive obligation actions.

counting_bases.note: award_count / unique_awards = distinct awards in the warehouse profile. Summing per-FY award counts double-counts awards with actions in multiple years. recent_* rows are obligation actions (often modifications), not unique awards.

top_agencies_note: Showing top 5 of 6 agencies by net obligations (includes $0/negative nets). Cap is explicit.
recent_awards_note: recent_awards are dollar-bearing obligation actions (often modifications). See counting_bases for unique awards in this sample.

historical_set_asides.note: Historical set-aside codes observed on warehouse award actions. This is not current SAM certification status and does not establish graduation or an exit reason. Historical set-aside retrieval was partial. Sampled from recent_awards on this profile call — not a full-history census.

totals_note: Profile dollars may come from a parent rollup; award history is one UEI. Do not treat the two totals as the same figure.
